task: get a concrete task done with an AI chat assistant (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot): pose a real task — draft an email, plan a trip, summarize a document, write or fix something, generate an image — iterate on the response at least once, and end with a usable result; complete when the refined result is on screen and accepted (copied, downloaded, or applied). Surface pinned: the assistant's own chat interface — not news about AI, not prompt-tips listicles without a live session.

tree.label: Complete a task with an AI assistant
